description: Reconstruction of Harmonizome/DRC-style gene-set libraries by aggregating sample-level expression signatures into biologically defined groups using a transparent consensus rule
rationale: Use hz_consensus when the library is clearly derived from the Harmonizome/DRC processing lineage, but the exact historical aggregation implementation is unavailable or not represented by a specific notebook. These models preserve the original biological grouping and signature intent while using a documented, scientifically defensible consensus procedure for reimplementation.
